messages:
Aisha (Partnerships): Hey team — final pass on the NexusGrid co-marketing bundle. I uploaded PDFs + SVGs to the Figma file (link in thread). Need checks on: logo lockup spacing, badge wording (they suggested 'Powered by Redwood'), alt-text, and marketplace thumbnail crop. Goal: publish next Tue. Can design + legal + marcom sign-off by EOD Friday?

Marco (Design): Saw the file. Quick notes: their kit includes a vertical mark and a horizontal lockup — use the horizontal for 16:9 thumbnail. Export plan: 1x + 2x PNGs, SVG badge variants, and a 1200x628 marketplace tile. Color clash: NexusGrid uses #0A6FFF which sits very close to our primary blue; propose neutral outline or using their charcoal for contrast. Overlay suggestion: rgba(0,0,0,0.35) for text panels. Minimum logo width for thumbnail: 72px. I'll drop exports in Figma > assets > partner-exports.

Priya (Legal): Legal flags: their brand guidelines require the notice 'NexusGrid® is a registered trademark of Nexus Systems' on external collateral. Also their logo usage doc says: 'Do not combine with other trademarks without prior consent.' We need explicit written publicity consent to publish quotes/case excerpts — MSA covers technical integration but not publicity. Please loop in partner legal.

Ben (MarCom): Copy questions: which badge do we use — their 'Hardware Partner' or our 'Validated on'? Also draft copy options: 1) 'Built with Redwood Inference + NexusGrid' 2) 'Optimized for NexusGrid hardware with Redwood Inference'. Which is less risky legally? Also alt text suggestion for tile: 'NexusGrid and Redwood Inference dashboard showing reduced latency.'

Ravi (AE): I'll ping their PM and legal now. They sent a badge pack earlier but didn't include a 'Validated on' lockup — might be a quick ask to partner design. If partner legal wants to approve final art, we should send mockups by Wed.

Marco (Design): I can create 'Validated on' badge variants that match their clearspace. Will add SVG and PNG 1x/2x. Example badge spec I'll include in the export: codeblock:

```
Badge specs:
- SVG: validated-on-redwood.svg
- Clearspace: 8px (min)
- Color variants: full color / monochrome-white / monochrome-black
- Sizes: 24px, 48px, 96px
```

Priya (Legal): Also confirm: they used a customer quote in their kit but didn't attach a signed publicity release. If we want to run the quote verbatim, we need their sign-off. Otherwise we publish anonymized numbers or 'partner reportedly reduced...'.

Sofia (Applied ML): On the technical claim — Ben's draft says 'Lowered inference cost by 3x on NexusGrid' — we should qualify that: 'reduced inference cost by up to 3x for this workload' or include the workload context. I'll provide a one-liner we can use: 'Reduced inference costs by up to 3x on NexusGrid for conversational search workloads.'

Ben (MarCom): Good call — I'll switch to 'up to 3x' and add the workload qualifier. Priya, can you share the email template for partner legal sign-off? Ravi — please request partner to sign off on quote + final art.

Ravi (AE): Partner PM replied — they can approve the quote but want to see final artwork and tile copy before granting publicity consent. They asked for mockups by Wed morning. I'll confirm timing.

Aisha (Partnerships): Timeline recap / action items:
- Marco: create SVG/PNG variants + 'Validated on' badge mockups and 3x tile comps (due Wed 10:00am).
- Ben: prepare marketplace tile + 3 social card drafts, use 'up to 3x' phrasing + workload qualifier (due Thu).
- Priya: draft partner legal approval email + trademark wording to include on collateral (due Fri EOD).
- Ravi: secure partner sign-off on quote and artwork (target Wed afternoon).
- Sofia: supply the one-line technical qualifier for copy (done).

If legal doesn't sign off by Fri EOD, fallback is anonymized case summary (no company name/quote). I'll track this on the partnership board and ping folks if we fall behind. :raised_hands: 

Marco (Design): Uploaded exports and badge variations to Figma > assets > partner-exports (files: nexus_thumbnail_1200x628.png, nexus_tile_2x.png, validated-on-badge.svg). Dropped a short img alt text list too.

Ben (MarCom): Draft tiles are in the marketing folder. Alt text we plan to use: 'Dashboard view of NexusGrid hardware running Redwood Inference, showing latency and cost graphs.' Priya — any issues with that alt text?

Priya (Legal): Alt text ok. Please add the trademark line in small footer: 'NexusGrid® is a registered trademark of Nexus Systems.' Also include partner's requested brand credit line if they provide one.

Ravi (AE): Partner legal reviewed mockups and approved copy + the 'up to 3x' phrasing. They approved with the condition we add the trademark line and send final art for a last pass. They asked we not use the word 'benchmark' without their test details.

Aisha (Partnerships): Excellent — closing loop. We'll publish next Tue as planned assuming final art is approved. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up once partner legal signs the final art pass.
